name: Villadangos del Páramo (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a yellow square at the centre bearing the crowned municipal arms of Villadangos del Páramo (three ears of wheat on blue and a bridge above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Villadangos del Páramo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villadangos del Páramo arms — three ears of wheat on blue and a bridge above waves
bridge and waves of the arms
